classification.difficultyReason: This is the same structure as p14-q1 (two elevations, perpendicular ground legs, Pythagoras), but the student must plan the whole solution without the scaffold. It has no later parts and no bearings.

content.prompt: A drone $T$ hovers $45\text{ m}$ directly above a point $D$ on level ground. From a point $P$ due west of $D$, the angle of elevation of the drone is $28^\circ$. From a point $Q$ due south of $D$, the angle of elevation is $35^\circ$. Find the distance $PQ$, to the nearest metre.
